pages.title: Overview
pages.text: The name $(#AA00AA)Pentacle$() in this context refers to ritual drawings of any shape, not just five-pointed stars. $(br2)Pentacles are used to summon and bind spirits from $(#AA00AA)The Other Place$().$(br)

Each pentacle consists of a central golden ritual bowl, surrounding runes of various colors$(br) and occult paraphernalia that improve the intended effect in various ways.$(br2)They act both as a device to call $()
on the entity, an amplifier for the summoner's commanding power$(br) and as a protecting circle preventing attacks from within against the summoner.$(br)
The combination of chosen runes and supporting items as well as their exact spatial positioning$(br) determines the use and effectiveness of the pentacle.$(br)

Ingredients are placed in $(item)Sacrificial Bowls$()$(br) near the pentacle. Specifically, must be placed $(bold)anywhere$() within$(br) 8 blocks horizontally of the central $(item)Golden Sacrificial Bowl$().$(br) The exact location does not matter.$()
